Knot-group representations, branched-cover bounds and explicit sharp families.

## Arithmetic fibres, discriminants and restricted-prime sums

Constructive finite etale fibres, arithmetic failures and discriminant geometry. Restricted-prime sums and primitive Eisenstein norm sumsets have a separate internally complete manuscript.

**Authored assessment:** The exact elliptic six-prime coefficient is 2081912199403/9893175318390; the certified-field coefficient is 13361/114520. The proved two-primary Sha vanishing and all-prime Selmer parity make dim Sha[p] even without assuming Sha finite. Outside finite exceptions, the actual class-group multiplicity c_p recovers dim Sha[p]=2 floor((c_p-1)/2); a third copy occurs exactly when Sha[p] is nonzero. Serre and uniform Kummer theory give open adelic affine image. Every fixed good-order Fourier mode now has arithmetic factoring-density bounds, and projected averaged pole measures converge weakly to an equivalent-Haar measure with positive L2 density. Growing-order tails, recurrence and Hasse infinitude remain open. Eventual Eisenstein equal-thirds balance also has an independent finite-polynomial proof. The coordinate-tail counterexample shows why Ro, rather than n, is the required sieve normalization.
